name: Extra hand plays
author: DecompRecomp
description: Play more than one card from the hand each turn. After a play the hand comes back up; the player may skip the rest with START. The CPU plays its extra cards through its own hand script.

settings.label: Hand plays per turn
settings.description: How many times a turn the hand comes up. A fusion or a card used from the hand counts as one play. 1 is the original game.

settings.label: Show skip hint
settings.description: While an extra hand is up for the player, say that START skips it.
